title: Iran Interior Minister in Doha for Security, Trade Talks; Missing Pilots Case Discussed
text:
Iran Interior Minister in Doha for Security, Trade Talks; Missing Pilots Case Discussed"

"DOHA, QATAR — OCTOBER 6, 2026"

"Iranian Interior Minister Eskandar Momeni arrived in Doha yesterday afternoon (Oct. 5) for an official visit at the invitation of Qatari Interior Minister Sheikh Khalifa bin Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani. He was received by Qatari Minister of State Abdulaziz bin Faisal."

"Talks focused on security and economic-trade cooperation. Momeni said issues including organized crime, coastguard cooperation, security matters and drug-related issues were discussed, and it was agreed that a security experts’ meeting be held immediately after the visit and that these meetings continue on a regular basis."

""
"SOT1, Eskandar Momeni, Iran's Interior Minister (Farsi) (00:07 - 00:29):  "Issues such as organized crime, coastguard cooperation, security matters, and drug-related issues were discussed, and it was agreed that a security experts’ meeting be held immediately after our visit and that these meetings continue on a regular basis.""

"SOT2, Eskandar Momeni, Iran's Interior Minister (Farsi) (00:47 - 01:06):  "We expressed our appreciation for the fair and mediatory role played by Qatar, together with Pakistan, [between Iran and the United States] and discussions were held in this regard, with the hope that tensions be reduced and the shadow of war be lifted from the region.""

"SOT3, Eskandar Momeni, Iran's Interior Minister (Farsi) (01:15 - 01:37):  "They [the Qataris] emphasized that Iranian products were of high quality and that the products suited [Qatari] people's taste and they held a very positive view of the products. It was agreed that, alongside economic, cultural, political, and security relations, trade relations also be further developed.
